task.description:
WF-03 Step 3 implement Q-1054 / GH #2400 (local record docs/issues/ISS-1061.yaml) as ELIXIR-DEV (.claude/agents/elixir-dev.md; test-support code in test/support/ is in scope). Implement EXACTLY the design in handoffs/WF03-ISS1054DBGUARD-20261012/step-01-issue-fixer.json, validated PASS in step-02b-code-design-validator.json, WITH these corrections from the validator: (1) use Keyword.get(Repo.config(), :database) not fetch! (fail closed with ArgumentError, never KeyError) and write raises in block form; (2) T4 asserts no public.tenants row with the unique slug_prefix used by the refused call and unchanged live-pool stats; keep the global tenant_% schema / tenants counts only as a secondary before/after delta (note tenant_template matches tenant_%); (3) T5: wrap the GenServer.start of the Pool in ExUnit.CaptureLog.capture_log to silence the crash report; (4) T6 = run the WHOLE existing pool test file plus test/support/tenant_fixture_dispatch_test.exs and any other tenant-fixture tests (grep test/ for start_pool!) unchanged and green; (5) also create test/specs/ISS-1061.md (short spec: criteria -> tests T1..T5, mutants M1..M7) like other test/specs files if that convention exists (check ls test/specs). Keep the diff minimal: test/support/tenant_fixture.ex, test/letflow/support/tenant_fixture_pool_test.exs, test/specs/ISS-1061.md, optional one paragraph in lib/letflow/design/iss1042-pooled-tenant-fixture.md, optional docs/anti-patterns.md only if a real new lesson. The unguarded fresh-clone / TenantTemplate paths are OUT of scope (state so in the module doc, one sentence).

MUTANTS (run each for real, quote the failing test names): apply M1 (guard removed in start_pool!/2), M2 (guard moved after GenServer.start/create_slots), M3a/M3b (always-unequal / always-equal compare), M4 (ignore :expected_database override), M5 (guard removed in Pool.init/1), M6 (prefix check removed), M7 (log instead of raise) one at a time to the working tree, run ONLY the new describe (mix test <file> --only describe:"ISS-1061 database guard" or by line), confirm it FAILS with the named tests, then restore (git checkout the file) and confirm a final clean green run. Never commit a mutant.

LOCAL GATES before push (each = ONE mix invocation under the mutex, one acquisition each): mix format --check-formatted; MIX_ENV=test mix letflow.check.static; MIX_ENV=test mix letflow.check_async_sandbox_reachability; mix letflow.lint_handoffs; the pool test file + dispatch test file + any other start_pool! adopter test files (unchanged, green). Quote the real output and test counts. DB: throwaway Postgres on 5499 only (docker run -d --rm --name pg1054 -e POSTGRES_USER=letflow -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=letflow -e POSTGRES_DB=letflow_dev -p 5499:5432 postgres:16 -c max_connections=200; run tests with LETFLOW_DB_PORT=5499; docker rm -f pg1054 at the end). Do not touch any other container/DB.

MACHINE RULE: ONE BEAM at a time machine-wide, one mutex acquisition per mix invocation: L=/c/Users/tvolo/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/mixlock; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$L")"; until mkdir "$L" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 20; done; trap 'rmdir "$L" 2>/dev/null' EXIT; cd /c/Users/tvolo/dev/ai-dala/letflow && LETFLOW_DB_PORT=5499 MIX_ENV=test <ONE mix invocation> 2>&1 . Batch the mutants sensibly (one test invocation per mutant). Foreground/polling only; no Monitors.

Then commit (pull --rebase first; message references [Q-1054 / GH #2400 / ISS-1061], ends 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>') and push to feature/WF03-ISS1054DBGUARD-20261012 with bounded retry on github resolve failures. Result into this handoff (COMPLETED, PASS/FAIL, no BOM, LF, no self reference in artifacts_out). Reply: diff summary, test counts, mutant table, gate outputs. Do NOT open a PR, never merge.
